points.title: Validation
points.must: An automatic check by the computer when data is entered that the data is sensible and follows the rules; invalid data is rejected with an error message.

points.title: Validation checks
points.must: At least five of: presence, range, type, length, format (picture), lookup (list), uniqueness — what each checks.

points.title: Examples of the checks
points.must: An example rule for each check, e.g. Mark 0–100 (range), StudentID S + 4 digits (format), Grade 11 or 12 (lookup).

points.title: Choosing a check
points.must: The check must match the data: range for numbers and dates, lookup for a short list, length plus format for a phone number.

points.title: Combining checks
points.must: One field can have several checks, e.g. StudentID: presence + format + uniqueness.

points.title: Verification
points.must: Checking that data was copied correctly from the source: double entry and visual check (proofreading).

points.title: Validation vs verification
points.must: Validation checks data is sensible / allowed; verification checks it was entered correctly; validation cannot prove data is correct (78 typed instead of 87).

points.title: Test data
points.must: Normal (accepted), boundary / extreme (on the limits, accepted) and erroneous (rejected) data, with an example for one rule.

points.title: Validation rules in SQL
points.must: NOT NULL (presence), UNIQUE / PRIMARY KEY, CHECK for range or lookup, FOREIGN KEY … REFERENCES.

points.title: Steps to create a data dictionary
points.must: List tables (from the ERD), list fields, choose type and size, mark PK and FK, add validation, format, description and example; check the entries.

points.title: Choosing data types and sizes
points.must: Codes and phone numbers → VARCHAR; money → DECIMAL(p,s); yes/no → BOOLEAN; dates → DATE; VARCHAR(n) sized from the longest value, CHAR(n) fixed length.

points.title: Matching keys
points.must: A foreign key has the same data type and size as the primary key it refers to.

points.title: A complete example
points.must: A data dictionary table for a whole table with type, size, key, validation, description and example for every field.
